recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not restore the exact FHIR-20651 wording, because that would discard later accepted clarifications; any future editorial typo cleanup in the current comment should be handled separately.
issue_request: FHIR-20651 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested replacing the old Resource.id comment saying create was the only no-id case with looser wording that resources typically have ids except for cases like create and conditional updates.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit bebeb7208891d96d47bac8305e6382ec303b6e66, which changed source/resource/structuredefinition-Resource.xml from the old create-only sentence to wording mentioning create and conditional updates. Jira records HL7/fhir#1124 as the application PR.
additional_context: Later same-family Resource.id issues refined the wording. FHIR-23741 scoped Resource.id guidance to RESTful contexts, FHIR-27052 changed the same comment to the current RESTful-interactions wording, FHIR-26688 corrected conditional-update id handling, and FHIR-42909 added broader no-logical-id examples to the Resource narrative. All four related issues already have Issue-Reconcile-Key audit commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Resource.id comment no longer contains the old strict create-only rule, still names create and conditional update as exceptions in RESTful interactions, and includes later accepted use-case qualification. The Resource Logical ID narrative also lists broader cases where ids may be absent.
